page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture utilizing a dedicated Hygon 7447v processor running at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance is configured with 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs, establishing a one-to-one mapping with one thread per core. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 7 Gbps. A key architectural characteristic of the Hygon 7447v processor in this configuration is the absence of advanced instruction sets such as AVX, AVX512, AMX, and hardware-accelerated cryptography flags like AES or SHA. This lack of specialized vector and matrix extensions represents a performance tradeoff for workloads reliant on heavy mathematical acceleration or native cryptographic offloading.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation provides predictable compute performance without resource contention, making it suitable for sustained workloads. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include web serving, batch processing, application servers, and general-purpose compute tasks that do not rely on specialized CPU instruction sets or local high-speed storage.
